start.speaker: Narrator
start.text: You wake up in a dark forest. The air is thick with the smell of pine and something... metallic.

choices.text: Go left towards the sound of water.
Go right towards the flickering light.

river.speaker: Narrator
river.text: You reach a rushing river. The water is freezing cold.

cabin.speaker: Old Man
cabin.text: Welcome, traveler. You look like you've seen better days.

drowned.speaker: Narrator
drowned.text: The current was too strong. You are lost.

bridge.speaker: Narrator
bridge.text: You find a rickety wooden bridge.

fire.speaker: Old Man
fire.text: The fire warms your bones. You feel safe here... for now.
